entries.note: v0.42.3 idle calibration bug, re-expressed as the old absolute-axis check while keeping the stored neutral trace. Pilot kill is indirect: the console focus-target assertion fires before the idle assertion. Keep as a gate-ordering finding; a dedicated idle-only check should make the kill precise. Baseline control must pass; this entry is knowingly indirect and is reported separately.
